rows.label: tlk43320142_01_msg0001
rows.name:
After the stuff that happened, we
decided not to let the kids go out
to play without a grown-up on hand.

rows.label: tlk43320142_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I thought the children would object,
as if we were keeping watch on them...

rows.label: tlk43320142_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Instead, they were thrilled to get a
close look at how mercenaries fight,
so they agreed to have us along.

rows.label: tlk43320142_01_msg0004
rows.name:
But you need to watch out
for Jillwood.

rows.label: tlk43320142_01_msg0005
rows.name:
I can't shake the feeling he's
bound to get himself into trouble.
